_comment: Seed spec for the MCSP knowledge-network corpus (issue #1). This file is the ONLY place papers enter the system. Fields: slug (stable id), tier (A-G per the PRD), title (search hint - OpenAlex resolution is authoritative), doi (only when verified from a source in hand), year/authors_hint (disambiguation aids), confirm (true = draft-uncertain, surface prominently in the manifest for Jade's audit), existing_raw (path in the vault raw/ - dedup, no download), deferred (true = intentionally unresolved placeholder, skipped by the builder).
